fixture_policy: Synthetic token, broadcaster, follower rows, timestamps, and API responses only. No real Twitch account, credential, response body, trace, HAR, or local profile path is included.

capture.after: Final static export after follower diagnostic changes
capture.states: Normal success, existing HTTP 500 error, and empty optional user metadata recovery.
capture.settling: Before each capture the pointer was moved to the lower-right blank area, the page was allowed to settle for 500 ms, and Playwright screenshot animations were disabled.
capture.comparison: Compared byte length and SHA-256 first; only differing PNGs were decoded with sharp and compared as RGBA pixels. No masking or cropping was used.

images.interpretation: The only difference is four red error-panel border pixels with a maximum channel delta of 1; there is no visible state, text, layout, hover, or ripple change.

before.state: generic follower error; no follower rows

after.state: Follower lists updated; synthetic rows rendered

interpretation: With deterministic pointer and animation settling, desktop and phone normal-success captures and the phone HTTP 500-error capture are byte-identical. The desktop HTTP 500-error capture has only four red error-panel border pixels with a maximum channel delta of 1 and no visible UI/state change. The after-recovery capture is byte-identical to the after-normal success capture; the optional user metadata recovery itself intentionally changes from a generic error with no rows to the normal success grid.
